translations.en: N-next time I get kidnapped, I'll make sure I can escape on my own!
Before that, you should try being careful enough not to get kidnapped!
You've been so distracted lately, @7rFiore@0r!
But I'm a young woman! What's wrong with
daydreaming as I walk?
I could turn a corner and find a prince holding a bouquet of roses,
saying, "You're my ideal princess!"
He'd shower me with jewelry and everything. And then...
@7rTanya@0r gives a weary shrug, and you both decide
to leave @7rFiore@0r to her endless chatter.
Hurry, hurry!
Please save @7rFiore@0r!
Mmm...
I'm sorry...
Huh?
Isn't @7rFiore@0r with you?
I want to say sorry to @7rFiore@0r too.
She might still be where she was before,
so I'll go and get her!
What's wrong? Hurry, go save her!
Otherwise they'll take @7rFiore@0r away somewhere!
Oh! You'll save @7rFiore@0r?
Please, please help her!
I'm sure @7rFiore@0r is waiting for you to save her!
I know she is!
Remembering all the help she has given you,
you decide to go and rescue @7rFiore@0r.
Yay! Thank you!
@7rFiore@0r was by the city entrance!
You do not know how long it has been,
but judging by @7rTanya's@0r behavior,
they cannot have gone very far.
You decide to go with @7rTanya@0r
and chase after the people who took @7rFiore@0r.
@7rFiore@0r is a thief by trade, after all.
She should be able to escape on her own somehow.
Thinking this, you refuse to help.
Why?! Why won't you?!
@7rFiore's@0r a girl! I'm sure she's waiting for help!
Mmmmmph!
You really won't go and save her?
Mmmmmmmmm...
With an expression that makes you feel truly guilty for refusing,
@7rTanya@0r droops in disappointment.
It's terrible, terrible, terrible!
The moment you speak to the distraught @7rTanya@0r,
@7rTanya@0r starts babbling in a panicked rush.
It's terrible! Somebody kidnapped @7rFiore@0r!
There were two or three big grown-up men,
and they took her away!
Seeing @7rTanya@0r so frantic, you feel sorry for her,
but somehow the phrases "serves her right" and "serves her right"
keep running through your mind.
It's terrible! We have to hurry and save her!
I'll pay you properly, so please help her!
Now, what should you do?
With her cheeks puffed out, she stares at you.
Faced with @7rTanya's@0r gaze, you think it over.
I'm sorry about today...
I dragged you along on such a pointless errand...
But anyone would wonder if there was a chance.
We all want to get out of this prison of a city alive.
I'm only thinking what any normal person would!
When you remain silent,
@7rCyrus@0r lets his shoulders droop.
Being blamed without a word is the hardest thing...
I know, I know. Would any decent person
really abandon their friends...?
But... I don't want to die...
Thank you for today.
Here's something to thank you.
From @7rCyrus@0r, you received a reward of @3r85,000 G@0r.
After handing you the reward,
@7rCyrus@0r shuffles away dejectedly.
Come on, let's get moving.
We're wasting time standing around!
Huh? Are you going to accept?
Please, I'm begging you!
There's nobody else I can ask!
I'm serious! I'm really asking for your help,

context: Fiore jokes about her romantic daydreams after rescue; Tanya pleads for help; Cyrus later regrets an escape attempt.
